title: REGIONAL HEALTH PROPERTIES, INC 8-K Filing — 2026-04-10
summary: Regional Health Properties, Inc. (a small-cap healthcare REIT) filed an 8-K disclosing that CFO Mark Stockslager resigned effective April 6, 2026, with no disagreement cited. CEO Brent Morrison assumed interim CFO duties until a successor is appointed.
key_points: CFO Mark Stockslager resigned from positions as CFO, Principal Financial Officer, and Principal Accounting Officer effective April 6, 2026.
The resignation was explicitly stated not to be due to any disagreement with the Company on operations, policies, or practices.
Stockslager will assist the Company in an advisory capacity during a transition period.
CEO Brent Morrison assumed interim duties as Principal Financial Officer and Principal Accounting Officer.
No changes were made to compensation arrangements for Morrison in connection with the additional responsibilities.
why_it_matters: This is a routine corporate governance matter for a small-cap healthcare REIT. It has no relevance to market structure or macro catalysts and would not be material to broader financial markets.
